# Craniologie

> > Premium ski and snowboard helmet and goggle specialist with expert fitting services (Headucators) and retail locations in Colorado's top ski destinations.

Craniologie offers curated collections from leading brands including Smith, Giro, Oakley, Sweet Protection, POC, KASK, and Anon, with specialized educational resources on helmet safety, fit systems, and goggle technology. The company operates physical stores in Vail and Beaver Creek with professional fitting services, plus ebike rentals in Frisco and Breckenridge.

## Key Topics

- MIPS technology
- Headucators (expert fitters)
- Smith, Giro, Oakley, Sweet Protection, POC, KASK, Anon
- Helmet safety & certification
- Goggle lens technology (photochromic, magnetic interchange)
- Helmet fit systems
- Goggle fog prevention
- OTG (over-the-glass) compatibility
- Replacement lenses
- EPS/EPP foam construction
- Helmet ventilation systems
- Olympic-grade equipment
- GoPro & electronics integration
- Colorado ski destinations (Vail, Beaver Creek, Breckenridge, Frisco)
